Restaurant

Three cuisines, a thousand flavours

Moroccan warmth, French refinement, and Italian soul — prepared on site by our chef and served with care, every day.

On-site dining

Variety, balance, and pleasure at every meal

Our restaurant is the heart of daily life at Maison Calista. Menus rotate through Moroccan, French, and Italian traditions — offering variety without sacrificing nutritional balance.

A chef is on site every day, working with fresh ingredients and adapting dishes to individual preferences, intolerances, and special diets. Full board is included in all packages — breakfast, lunch, and dinner, served in our dining room or on the terrace overlooking the pool and Atlas Mountains.

Three cuisines

Moroccan · French · Italian

Three cuisines, a thousand flavours — a rotating calendar that keeps mealtimes joyful, familiar, and surprising in equal measure.

Moroccan

Tagines, couscous, fresh herbs, and the generous spices of local tradition — authentic flavours prepared with respect for regional craft.

French

Classic techniques, seasonal produce, and the comfort of familiar flavours — particularly welcome for residents from France and Belgium.

Italian

Pasta, risotto, and Mediterranean lightness — simple, joyful, and satisfying. A gentle counterpoint to Moroccan richness.

Personalised nutrition

Preferences, intolerances, and special diets

We take dietary needs seriously. Whether a resident prefers lighter meals, requires texture adaptation, or follows a specific medical diet, our kitchen team prepares accordingly — with the same attention to flavour and presentation.

Selected packages also include restaurant outings beyond the residence: monthly outings with Well-Being and Comfort, weekly outings and café gourmand with Signature, plus à-la-carte dining options for our most complete experience.

Dining by package
